[31m+ export function actionBadgeCategory(action: string): "destructive" | "constructive" | "update" | "other" {[39m
[31m+   if (/delete|remove|revoke|disable/i.test(action)) return "destructive";[39m
[31m+   if (/create|add|enable|approve/i.test(action)) return "constructive";[39m
[31m+   if (/update|edit|change|modify/i.test(action)) return "update";[39m
[31m+   return "other";[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function actionBadgeClass(action: string): string {[39m
[31m+   const cat = actionBadgeCategory(action);[39m
[31m+   switch (cat) {[39m
[31m+     case "destructive": return "badge bad";[39m
[31m+     case "constructive": return "badge ok";[39m
[31m+     case "update": return "badge warn";[39m
[31m+     default: return "badge muted";[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ export function filterEvents(events: AuditEvent[], filters: AuditFilters): AuditEvent[] {[39m
[31m+   return events.filter(evt => {[39m
[31m+     if (filters.dateRange !== "all") {[39m
[31m+       const days = { "7d": 7, "30d": 30, "90d": 90 }[filters.dateRange];[39m
[31m+       const cutoff = Date.now() - days * 86_400_000;[39m
[31m+       if (new Date(evt.occurred_at).getTime() < cutoff) return false;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (filters.actionCategory !== "all") {[39m
[31m+       if (actionBadgeCategory(evt.action) !== filters.actionCategory) return false;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (filters.actorType !== "all" && evt.actor_type !== filters.actorType) return false;[39m
[31m+     return true;[39m

[31m+ function formatRelativeTime(iso: string): string {[39m
[31m+   const diff = Date.now() - new Date(iso).getTime();[39m
[31m+   const minutes = Math.floor(diff / 60_000);[39m
[31m+   if (minutes < 1) return "agora";[39m
[31m+   if (minutes < 60) return `há ${minutes}m`;[39m
[31m+   const hours = Math.floor(minutes / 60);[39m
[31m+   if (hours < 24) return `há ${hours}h`;[39m
[31m+   const days = Math.floor(hours / 24);[39m
[31m+   return `há ${days}d`;[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ export function actionBadgeCategory(action: string): "destructive" | "constructive" | "update" | "other" {[39m
[31m+   if (/delete|remove|revoke|disable/i.test(action)) return "destructive";[39m
[31m+   if (/create|add|enable|approve/i.test(action)) return "constructive";[39m
[31m+   if (/update|edit|change|modify/i.test(action)) return "update";[39m
[31m+   return "other";[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function actionBadgeClass(action: string): string {[39m
[31m+   const cat = actionBadgeCategory(action);[39m
[31m+   switch (cat) {[39m
[31m+     case "destructive": return "badge bad";[39m
[31m+     case "constructive": return "badge ok";[39m
[31m+     case "update": return "badge warn";[39m
[31m+     default: return "badge muted";[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ export function filterEvents(events: AuditEvent[], filters: AuditFilters): AuditEvent[] {[39m
[31m+   return events.filter(evt => {[39m
[31m+     if (filters.dateRange !== "all") {[39m
[31m+       const days = { "7d": 7, "30d": 30, "90d": 90 }[filters.dateRange];[39m
[31m+       const cutoff = Date.now() - days * 86_400_000;[39m
[31m+       if (new Date(evt.occurred_at).getTime() < cutoff) return false;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (filters.actionCategory !== "all") {[39m
[31m+       if (actionBadgeCategory(evt.action) !== filters.actionCategory) return false;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (filters.actorType !== "all" && evt.actor_type !== filters.actorType) return false;[39m
[31m+     return true;[39m
[31m+   });[39m

[31m+ function formatRelativeTime(iso: string): string {[39m
[31m+   const diff = Date.now() - new Date(iso).getTime();[39m
[31m+   const minutes = Math.floor(diff / 60_000);[39m
[31m+   if (minutes < 1) return "agora";[39m
[31m+   if (minutes < 60) return `há ${minutes}m`;[39m
[31m+   const hours = Math.floor(minutes / 60);[39m
[31m+   if (hours < 24) return `há ${hours}h`;[39m
[31m+   const days = Math.floor(hours / 24);[39m
[31m+   return `há ${days}d`;[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ export function actionBadgeCategory(action: string): "destructive" | "constructive" | "update" | "other" {[39m
[31m+   if (/delete|remove|revoke|disable/i.test(action)) return "destructive";[39m
[31m+   if (/create|add|enable|approve/i.test(action)) return "constructive";[39m
[31m+   if (/update|edit|change|modify/i.test(action)) return "update";[39m
[31m+   return "other";[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function actionBadgeClass(action: string): string {[39m
[31m+   const cat = actionBadgeCategory(action);[39m
[31m+   switch (cat) {[39m
[31m+     case "destructive": return "badge bad";[39m
[31m+     case "constructive": return "badge ok";[39m
[31m+     case "update": return "badge warn";[39m
[31m+     default: return "badge muted";[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ export function filterEvents(events: AuditEvent[], filters: AuditFilters): AuditEvent[] {[39m
[31m+   return events.filter(evt => {[39m
[31m+     if (filters.dateRange !== "all") {[39m
[31m+       const days = { "7d": 7, "30d": 30, "90d": 90 }[filters.dateRange];[39m
[31m+       const cutoff = Date.now() - days * 86_400_000;[39m
[31m+       if (new Date(evt.occurred_at).getTime() < cutoff) return false;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (filters.actionCategory !== "all") {[39m
[31m+       if (actionBadgeCategory(evt.action) !== filters.actionCategory) return false;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (filters.actorType !== "all" && evt.actor_type !== filters.actorType) return false;[39m
[31m+     return true;[39m
[31m+   });[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ function formatRelativeTime(iso: string): string {[39m
[31m+   const diff = Date.now() - new Date(iso).getTime();[39m
[31m+   const minutes = Math.floor(diff / 60_000);[39m
[31m+   if (minutes < 1) return "agora";[39m
[31m+   if (minutes < 60) return `há ${minutes}m`;[39m
[31m+   const hours = Math.floor(minutes / 60);[39m
[31m+   if (hours < 24) return `há ${hours}h`;[39m
[31m+   const days = Math.floor(hours / 24);[39m
[31m+   return `há ${days}d`;[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function formatAbsoluteTime(iso: string): string {[39m
[31m+   return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("pt-BR", { dateStyle: "short", timeStyle: "short" }).format([39m
[31m+     new Date(iso),[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+   actionCategory: "destructive" | "constructive" | "update" | "all";[39m

[31m+ export function actionBadgeCategory(action: string): "destructive" | "constructive" | "update" | "other" {[39m
[31m+   if (/delete|remove|revoke|disable/i.test(action)) return "destructive";[39m
[31m+   if (/create|add|enable|approve/i.test(action)) return "constructive";[39m
[31m+   if (/update|edit|change|modify/i.test(action)) return "update";[39m
[31m+   return "other";[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function actionBadgeClass(action: string): string {[39m
[31m+   const cat = actionBadgeCategory(action);[39m
[31m+   switch (cat) {[39m
[31m+     case "destructive": return "badge bad";[39m
[31m+     case "constructive": return "badge ok";[39m
[31m+     case "update": return "badge warn";[39m
[31m+     default: return "badge muted";[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ export function filterEvents(events: AuditEvent[], filters: AuditFilters): AuditEvent[] {[39m
[31m+   return events.filter(evt => {[39m
[31m+     if (filters.dateRange !== "all") {[39m
[31m+       const days = { "7d": 7, "30d": 30, "90d": 90 }[filters.dateRange];[39m
[31m+       const cutoff = Date.now() - days * 86_400_000;[39m
[31m+       if (new Date(evt.occurred_at).getTime() < cutoff) return false;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (filters.actionCategory !== "all") {[39m
[31m+       if (actionBadgeCategory(evt.action) !== filters.actionCategory) return false;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (filters.actorType !== "all" && evt.actor_type !== filters.actorType) return false;[39m
[31m+     return true;[39m
[31m+   });[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ function formatRelativeTime(iso: string): string {[39m
[31m+   const diff = Date.now() - new Date(iso).getTime();[39m
[31m+   const minutes = Math.floor(diff / 60_000);[39m
[31m+   if (minutes < 1) return "agora";[39m
[31m+   if (minutes < 60) return `há ${minutes}m`;[39m
[31m+   const hours = Math.floor(minutes / 60);[39m
[31m+   if (hours < 24) return `há ${hours}h`;[39m
[31m+   const days = Math.floor(hours / 24);[39m
[31m+   return `há ${days}d`;[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function formatAbsoluteTime(iso: string): string {[39m
[31m+   return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("pt-BR", { dateStyle: "short", timeStyle: "short" }).format([39m
[31m+     new Date(iso),[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+   const header = "Data,Tipo Ator,Ator,Ação,Recurso,ID Recurso,ID Correlação";[39m
[31m+   const rows = events.map(e =>[39m

[31m+      e.resource_type, e.resource_id ?? "", e.correlation_id ?? ""].join(",")[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+   downloadCsv(header, rows, `auditoria-${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.csv`);[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+   actionCategory: "destructive" | "constructive" | "update" | "all";[39m

[31m+ // ── Pure functions (exported for testability) ────────────────────────────────[39m

[31m+ export function actionBadgeCategory(action: string): "destructive" | "constructive" | "update" | "other" {[39m
[31m+   if (/delete|remove|revoke|disable/i.test(action)) return "destructive";[39m
[31m+   if (/create|add|enable|approve/i.test(action)) return "constructive";[39m
[31m+   if (/update|edit|change|modify/i.test(action)) return "update";[39m
[31m+   return "other";[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function actionBadgeClass(action: string): string {[39m
[31m+   const cat = actionBadgeCategory(action);[39m
[31m+   switch (cat) {[39m
[31m+     case "destructive": return "badge bad";[39m
[31m+     case "constructive": return "badge ok";[39m
[31m+     case "update": return "badge warn";[39m
[31m+     default: return "badge muted";[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ export function filterEvents(events: AuditEvent[], filters: AuditFilters): AuditEvent[] {[39m
[31m+   return events.filter(evt => {[39m
[31m+     if (filters.dateRange !== "all") {[39m
[31m+       const days = { "7d": 7, "30d": 30, "90d": 90 }[filters.dateRange];[39m
[31m+       const cutoff = Date.now() - days * 86_400_000;[39m
[31m+       if (new Date(evt.occurred_at).getTime() < cutoff) return false;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (filters.actionCategory !== "all") {[39m
[31m+       if (actionBadgeCategory(evt.action) !== filters.actionCategory) return false;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (filters.actorType !== "all" && evt.actor_type !== filters.actorType) return false;[39m
[31m+     return true;[39m
[31m+   });[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function formatRelativeTime(iso: string): string {[39m
[31m+   const diff = Date.now() - new Date(iso).getTime();[39m
[31m+   const minutes = Math.floor(diff / 60_000);[39m
[31m+   if (minutes < 1) return "agora";[39m
[31m+   if (minutes < 60) return `há ${minutes}m`;[39m
[31m+   const hours = Math.floor(minutes / 60);[39m
[31m+   if (hours < 24) return `há ${hours}h`;[39m
[31m+   const days = Math.floor(hours / 24);[39m
[31m+   return `há ${days}d`;[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function formatAbsoluteTime(iso: string): string {[39m
[31m+   return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("pt-BR", { dateStyle: "short", timeStyle: "short" }).format([39m
[31m+     new Date(iso),[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ function exportCsv(events: AuditEvent[]): void {[39m
[31m+   const header = "Data,Tipo Ator,Ator,Ação,Recurso,ID Recurso,ID Correlação";[39m
[31m+   const rows = events.map(e =>[39m
[31m+     [e.occurred_at, e.actor_type, e.actor_id ?? "", e.action,[39m
[31m+      e.resource_type, e.resource_id ?? "", e.correlation_id ?? ""].join(",")[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+   downloadCsv(header, rows, `auditoria-${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.csv`);[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ function formatRelativeTime(iso: string): string {[39m
[31m+   const diff = Date.now() - new Date(iso).getTime();[39m
[31m+   const minutes = Math.floor(diff / 60_000);[39m

[31m+   if (/delete|remove|revoke|disable/i.test(action)) return "destructive";[39m
[31m+   if (/create|add|enable|approve/i.test(action)) return "constructive";[39m

[31m+   return "other";[39m

[31m+     case "destructive": return "badge bad";[39m
[31m+     case "constructive": return "badge ok";[39m
[31m+     case "update": return "badge warn";[39m

[31m+ function formatRelativeTime(iso: string): string {[39m
[31m+   const diff = Date.now() - new Date(iso).getTime();[39m
[31m+   const minutes = Math.floor(diff / 60_000);[39m
[31m+   if (minutes < 1) return "agora";[39m
[31m+   if (minutes < 60) return `há ${minutes}m`;[39m
[31m+   const hours = Math.floor(minutes / 60);[39m
[31m+   if (hours < 24) return `há ${hours}h`;[39m
[31m+   const days = Math.floor(hours / 24);[39m
[31m+   return `há ${days}d`;[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ interface AuditFilters {[39m
[31m+   dateRange: "7d" | "30d" | "90d" | "all";[39m
[31m+   actionCategory: "destructive" | "constructive" | "update" | "all";[39m
[31m+   actorType: "human" | "service" | "all";[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ // ── Pure functions (exported for testability) ────────────────────────────────[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ export function actionBadgeCategory(action: string): "destructive" | "constructive" | "update" | "other" {[39m
[31m+   if (/delete|remove|revoke|disable/i.test(action)) return "destructive";[39m
[31m+   if (/create|add|enable|approve/i.test(action)) return "constructive";[39m
[31m+   if (/update|edit|change|modify/i.test(action)) return "update";[39m
[31m+   return "other";[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function actionBadgeClass(action: string): string {[39m
[31m+   const cat = actionBadgeCategory(action);[39m
[31m+   switch (cat) {[39m
[31m+     case "destructive": return "badge bad";[39m
[31m+     case "constructive": return "badge ok";[39m
[31m+     case "update": return "badge warn";[39m
[31m+     default: return "badge muted";[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ export function filterEvents(events: AuditEvent[], filters: AuditFilters): AuditEvent[] {[39m
[31m+   return events.filter(evt => {[39m
[31m+     if (filters.dateRange !== "all") {[39m
[31m+       const days = { "7d": 7, "30d": 30, "90d": 90 }[filters.dateRange];[39m
[31m+       const cutoff = Date.now() - days * 86_400_000;[39m
[31m+       if (new Date(evt.occurred_at).getTime() < cutoff) return false;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (filters.actionCategory !== "all") {[39m
[31m+       if (actionBadgeCategory(evt.action) !== filters.actionCategory) return false;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (filters.actorType !== "all" && evt.actor_type !== filters.actorType) return false;[39m
[31m+     return true;[39m
[31m+   });[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function formatRelativeTime(iso: string): string {[39m
[31m+   const diff = Date.now() - new Date(iso).getTime();[39m
[31m+   const minutes = Math.floor(diff / 60_000);[39m
[31m+   if (minutes < 1) return "agora";[39m
[31m+   if (minutes < 60) return `há ${minutes}m`;[39m
[31m+   const hours = Math.floor(minutes / 60);[39m
[31m+   if (hours < 24) return `há ${hours}h`;[39m
[31m+   const days = Math.floor(hours / 24);[39m
[31m+   return `há ${days}d`;[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function formatAbsoluteTime(iso: string): string {[39m
[31m+   return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("pt-BR", { dateStyle: "short", timeStyle: "short" }).format([39m
[31m+     new Date(iso),[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function exportCsv(events: AuditEvent[]): void {[39m
[31m+   const header = "Data,Tipo Ator,Ator,Ação,Recurso,ID Recurso,ID Correlação";[39m
[31m+   const rows = events.map(e =>[39m
[31m+     [e.occurred_at, e.actor_type, e.actor_id ?? "", e.action,[39m
[31m+      e.resource_type, e.resource_id ?? "", e.correlation_id ?? ""].join(",")[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+   downloadCsv(header, rows, `auditoria-${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.csv`);[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ export function filterEvents(events: AuditEvent[], filters: AuditFilters): AuditEvent[] {[39m
[31m+   return events.filter(evt => {[39m
[31m+     if (filters.dateRange !== "all") {[39m
[31m+       const days = { "7d": 7, "30d": 30, "90d": 90 }[filters.dateRange];[39m
[31m+       const cutoff = Date.now() - days * 86_400_000;[39m
[31m+       if (new Date(evt.occurred_at).getTime() < cutoff) return false;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (filters.actionCategory !== "all") {[39m
[31m+       if (actionBadgeCategory(evt.action) !== filters.actionCategory) return false;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (filters.actorType !== "all" && evt.actor_type !== filters.actorType) return false;[39m
[31m+     return true;[39m
[31m+   });[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function formatRelativeTime(iso: string): string {[39m
[31m+   const diff = Date.now() - new Date(iso).getTime();[39m
[31m+   const minutes = Math.floor(diff / 60_000);[39m
[31m+   if (minutes < 1) return "agora";[39m
[31m+   if (minutes < 60) return `há ${minutes}m`;[39m
[31m+   const hours = Math.floor(minutes / 60);[39m
[31m+   if (hours < 24) return `há ${hours}h`;[39m
[31m+   const days = Math.floor(hours / 24);[39m
[31m+   return `há ${days}d`;[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function formatAbsoluteTime(iso: string): string {[39m
[31m+   return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("pt-BR", { dateStyle: "short", timeStyle: "short" }).format([39m
[31m+     new Date(iso),[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function exportCsv(events: AuditEvent[]): void {[39m
[31m+   const header = "Data,Tipo Ator,Ator,Ação,Recurso,ID Recurso,ID Correlação";[39m
[31m+   const rows = events.map(e =>[39m
[31m+     [e.occurred_at, e.actor_type, e.actor_id ?? "", e.action,[39m
[31m+      e.resource_type, e.resource_id ?? "", e.correlation_id ?? ""].join(",")[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+   downloadCsv(header, rows, `auditoria-${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.csv`);[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   useEffect(() => {[39m
[31m+     if (!props.me) {[39m
[31m+       setSubscription(null);[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     void load();[39m

[31m+     setLoading(true);[39m
[31m+     setMessage(null);[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const sub = await api.getBillingSubscription();[39m
[31m+       setSubscription(sub);[39m
[31m+     } catch (e) {[39m
[31m+       setMessage(readError(e));[39m
[31m+     } finally {[39m
[31m+       setLoading(false);[39m
[31m+     }[39m

[31m+       const { url } = await api.createBillingPortalSession({[39m
[31m+         return_url: window.location.href,[39m
[31m+       });[39m
[31m+       window.open(url, "_blank", "noopener,noreferrer");[39m
[31m+     } catch (e) {[39m
[31m+       setMessage(readError(e));[39m
[31m+     } finally {[39m
[31m+       setBusy(false);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m

  const isDirty = useMemo(
    () => rules !== null && lastSavedRules !== null && !deepEqual(rules, lastSavedRules),
    [rules, lastSavedRules],
  );

  const hasValidationErrors = Object.keys(validationErrors).length > 0;

  const fetchRules = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!props.me) {
      setRules(null);
      setAgentRules(null);
      setGate(\"idle\");
      setHint(null);
      return;
    }
    try {
      const rl = await api.getMerchantRules();
      setRules(rl);
      setLastSavedRules(rl);
      setGate(\"idle\");
      setHint(null);
    } catch (e) {
      setRules(null);
      setHint(null);
      if (e instanceof DashboardHttpError && e.status === 401) setGate(\"401\");
      else {
        setGate(\"error\");
        setHint(readError(e));
      }
    }
  }, [api, props.me]);

  useEffect(() => {
    void fetchRules();
  }, [fetchRules]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!props.me) return;
    void loadAgentRules();
  }, [props.me]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps

  async function loadAgentRules() {
    setAgentLoading(true);
    setAgentMessage(null);
    try {
      const ar = await api.getAgentRules();
      setAgentRules(ar);
    } catch (e) {
      setAgentMessage(readError(e));
    } finally {
      setAgentLoading(false);
    }
  }

  async function saveAgentRules() {
    if (!agentRules) return;
    setAgentBusy(true);
    setAgentMessage(null);
    try {
      const saved = await api.putAgentRules(agentRules);
      setAgentRules(saved);
      setAgentMessage(\"Regras do agente salvas.\");
    } catch (e) {
      setAgentMessage(
        e instanceof SyntaxError ? `JSON inválido: ${e.message}` : readError(e),
      );
    } finally {
      setAgentBusy(false);
    }
  }

  function runValidation(currentRules: MerchantRules) {
    const errors: Record<string, string> = {};

    const zipErr = validateOriginZip(currentRules.originZip);
    if (zipErr) errors.originZip = zipErr;

    const addrErr = validateTreasuryAddress(currentRules.cryptoPayments?.treasuryAddress);
    if (currentRules.cryptoPayments?.enabled && addrErr) errors.treasuryAddress = addrErr;

    const freeShipErr = validateNonNegative(currentRules.freeShippingMinCartValue);
    if (freeShipErr) errors.freeShippingMinCartValue = freeShipErr;

    const subsidyErr = validateNonNegative(currentRules.maxShippingSubsidy);
    if (subsidyErr) errors.maxShippingSubsidy = subsidyErr;

    const marginErr = validateMarginConsistency(
      currentRules.maxDiscountPercent,
      currentRules.minimumMarginPercent,
    );
    if (marginErr) errors.marginConsistency = marginErr;

    setValidationErrors(errors);
    return Object.keys(errors).length === 0;
  }

  function handleRulesChange(next: MerchantRules) {
    setRules(next);
    runValidation(next);
  }

  async function saveRules() {
    if (!rules) return;
    if (!runValidation(rules)) return;
    setSaving(true);
    setSaveResult(null);
    try {
      const saved = await api.putMerchantRules(rules);
      setRules(saved);
      setLastSavedRules(saved);
      setSaveResult(\"success\");
    } catch (e) {
      setSaveResult(\"error\");
      setHint(readError(e));
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  }

  const handleDismissFeedback = useCallback(() => setSaveResult(null), []);

  if (!props.me) {
    return (
      <>
        <h1>Regras (sessão JWT)</h1>
        <p className=\"page-lead\">
          Faça login na barra superior para ler e gravar <code>GET/PUT /merchants/me/rules</code> protegidas por 
cookie.
        </p>
      </>
    );
  }

  return (
    <>
      <header className=\"page-head\">
        <div>
          <span className=\"eyebrow\">Atendimento</span>
          <h1>Regras do Agente</h1>
          <p className=\"page-lead\">
            Defina o comportamento e os limites do agente de checkout.
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className=\"button-row\">
          {isDirty && <span className=\"badge-unsaved\">Alterações não salvas</span>}
          <button
            type=\"button\"
            className=\"primary-action\"
            disabled={saving || !rules || !isDirty || hasValidationErrors}
            onClick={() => void saveRules()}
            title={hasValidationErrors ? \"Corrija os erros antes de salvar\" : undefined}
          >
            <Save size={16} />
            {saving ? \"Salvando...\" : \"Salvar regras\"}
          </button>
        </div>
      </header>

      <div aria-live=\"polite\" aria-atomic=\"true\">
        <SaveFeedbackBanner
          result={saveResult}
          onDismiss={handleDismissFeedback}
        />
      </div>

      {gate === \"401\" ? (
        <div className=\"panel panel-warn\" role=\"alert\">
          <p>Sessão inválida ou expirada.</p>
          <button className=\"btn-sm\" onClick={() => window.location.reload()}>
            Fazer login novamente
          </button>
        </div>
      ) : null}
      {gate === \"error\" ? (
        <div className=\"panel panel-error\" role=\"alert\">
          <p>{hint ?? \"Falha de rede\"}</p>
          <button className=\"btn-sm\" onClick={() => void fetchRules()}>
            Tentar novamente
          </button>
        </div>
      ) : null}

      {rules ? (
        <div className=\"split-panel\">
          <div className=\"split-panel-controls\">
            <div className=\"panel stacked\">
              <div className=\"panel-title\">
                <h2>Capacidades</h2>
              <p className=\"page-lead\" style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: 12 }}>O que o agente pode fazer durante a 
conversa</p>
              </div>
              <RulesForm
                rules={rules}
                onChange={handleRulesChange}
                validationErrors={validationErrors}
                onValidationChange={setValidationErrors}
              />
            </div>

            <div className=\"panel stacked rules-section-gap\">
              <QuickRepliesSection
                value={rules.quickReplies}
                onChange={(qr) => handleRulesChange({ ...rules, quickReplies: qr })}
              />
            </div>

            <section className=\"panel stacked rules-section-gap\">
              <div className=\"panel-title\">
                <h2>Limites</h2>
                <Bot size={18} className=\"icon-brand\" />
              </div>
              <p className=\"page-lead\" style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: 12 }}>
                Restrições que o agente deve respeitar sempre
              </p>
              {agentMessage ? (
                <p className=\"panel panel-info\">{agentMessage}</p>
              ) : null}
              {agentLoading ? (
                <p className=\"panel panel-info\">Carregando regras do agente...</p>
              ) : null}
              <AgentRulesForm
                rules={agentRules}
                onChange={setAgentRules}
                mode={agentRulesMode}
                onModeChange={setAgentRulesMode}
                disabled={agentBusy}
                loading={agentLoading}
              />
              <div className=\"button-row\">
                <button
                  type=\"button\"
                  className=\"primary-action\"
                  disabled={agentBusy || agentLoading || !agentRules}
                  onClick={() => void saveAgentRules()}
                >
                  <Save size={16} />
                  {agentBusy ? \"Salvando...\" : \"Salvar regras\"}
                </button>
                <button
                  type=\"button\"
                  disabled={agentBusy || agentLoading}
                  onClick={() => void loadAgentRules()}
                >
                  Recarregar
                </button>
              </div>
            </section>
          </div>

          <div className=\"split-panel-preview\">
            <LivePreviewPanel
              ref={previewRef}
              apiBaseUrl={props.apiBaseUrl}
              me={props.me}
            />
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : gate === \"idle\" ? (
        <RulesSkeleton />
      ) : null}
    </>
  );
}

[31m+ export function moveItemInList<T extends { id: string }>([39m
[31m+   items: T[],[39m
[31m+   id: string,[39m
[31m+   direction: "up" | "down",[39m
[31m+ ): T[] {[39m
[31m+   const idx = items.findIndex((it) => it.id === id);[39m
[31m+   if (idx === -1) return items.slice();[39m
[31m+   const swapWith = direction === "up" ? idx - 1 : idx + 1;[39m
[31m+   if (swapWith < 0 || swapWith >= items.length) return items.slice();[39m
[31m+   const next = items.slice();[39m
[31m+   const a = next[idx]!;[39m
[31m+   const b = next[swapWith]!;[39m
[31m+   next[idx] = b;[39m
[31m+   next[swapWith] = a;[39m
[31m+   return next;[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+   id: string,[39m
[31m+   direction: "up" | "down",[39m
[31m+ ): T[] {[39m
[31m+   const idx = items.findIndex((it) => it.id === id);[39m
[31m+   if (idx === -1) return items.slice();[39m
[31m+   const swapWith = direction === "up" ? idx - 1 : idx + 1;[39m
[31m+   if (swapWith < 0 || swapWith >= items.length) return items.slice();[39m
[31m+   const next = items.slice();[39m
[31m+   const a = next[idx]!;[39m
[31m+   const b = next[swapWith]!;[39m
[31m+   next[idx] = b;[39m
[31m+   next[swapWith] = a;[39m
[31m+   return next;[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ export function filterTickets<T extends { id: string; buyerMessage: string }>([39m
[31m+   tickets: T[],[39m
[31m+   query: string,[39m
[31m+ ): T[] {[39m
[31m+   const q = query.trim().toLowerCase();[39m
[31m+   if (!q) return tickets.slice();[39m
[31m+   return tickets.filter([39m
[31m+     (t) =>[39m
[31m+       t.id.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||[39m
[31m+       (t.buyerMessage ?? "").toLowerCase().includes(q),[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ export function paginateItems<T>([39m
[31m+   items: T[],[39m
[31m+   page: number,[39m
[31m+   pageSize: number,[39m
[31m+ ): { paginated: T[]; hasMore: boolean } {[39m
[31m+   const start = (page - 1) * pageSize;[39m
[31m+   const paginated = items.slice(start, start + pageSize);[39m
[31m+   const hasMore = start + paginated.length < items.length;[39m
[31m+   return { paginated, hasMore };[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+   const api = useMemo(() => createDashboardApi({ baseUrl: props.apiBaseUrl }), [props.apiBaseUrl]);[39m
[31m+   const [settings, setSettings] = useState<SupportSettings | null>(null);[39m
[31m+   const [items, setItems] = useState<SupportFaqItem[]>([]);[39m
[31m+   const [tickets, setTickets] = useState<SupportTicket[]>([]);[39m
[31m+   const [ticketStatusFilter, setTicketStatusFilter] = useState<SupportTicketStatus | "all">("all");[39m
[31m+   const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);[39m
[31m+   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);[39m
[31m+   const [ticketBusy, setTicketBusy] = useState<string | null>(null);[39m
[31m+   const [message, setMessage] = useState<{ text: string; kind: "ok" | "error" } | null>(null);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   useEffect(() => {[39m
[31m+     if (!props.me) {[39m
[31m+       setSettings(null);[39m
[31m+       setItems([]);[39m
[31m+       setTickets([]);[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     void load();[39m
[31m+   }, [props.me, ticketStatusFilter]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   async function load() {[39m
[31m+     setLoading(true);[39m
[31m+     setMessage(null);[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const [s, t] = await Promise.all([[39m
[31m+         api.getSupportSettings(),[39m
[31m+         api.getSupportTickets(ticketStatusFilter === "all" ? undefined : ticketStatusFilter)[39m
[31m+       ]);[39m
[31m+       const settings = s && typeof s === "object" && !Array.isArray(s) ? s : null;[39m
[31m+       setSettings(settings);[39m
[31m+       setItems(settings?.faqItems ?? []);[39m
[31m+       setTickets(Array.isArray(t) ? t : []);[39m
[31m+     } catch (e) {[39m
[31m+       const text = e instanceof DashboardHttpError[39m
[31m+         ? e.responseBody.slice(0, 160)[39m
[31m+         : e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e);[39m
[31m+       setMessage({ text: `Erro ao carregar: ${text}`, kind: "error" });[39m
[31m+     } finally {[39m
[31m+       setLoading(false);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   async function save() {[39m
[31m+     setBusy(true);[39m
[31m+     setMessage(null);[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const saved = await api.putSupportSettings({ faqItems: items });[39m
[31m+       setSettings(saved);[39m
[31m+       setItems(saved.faqItems);[39m
[31m+       setMessage({ text: "FAQ salvo com sucesso.", kind: "ok" });[39m
[31m+     } catch (e) {[39m
[31m+       const text = e instanceof DashboardHttpError[39m
[31m+         ? e.responseBody.slice(0, 160)[39m
[31m+         : e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e);[39m
[31m+       setMessage({ text: `Erro ao salvar: ${text}`, kind: "error" });[39m
[31m+     } finally {[39m
[31m+       setBusy(false);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   function updateItem(id: string, field: "question" | "answer", val: string) {[39m
[31m+     setItems((prev) => prev.map((it) => (it.id === id ? { ...it, [field]: val } : it)));[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   function removeItem(id: string) {[39m
[31m+     setItems((prev) => prev.filter((it) => it.id !== id));[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   async function updateTicketStatus(ticketId: string, status: SupportTicketStatus) {[39m
[31m+     setTicketBusy(ticketId);[39m
[31m+     setMessage(null);[39m
[31m+     try {[39m

[31m+       setTickets((prev) => prev.map((ticket) => (ticket.id === ticketId ? updated : ticket)));[39m
[31m+       setMessage({ text: "Chamado atualizado.", kind: "ok" });[39m
[31m+     } catch (e) {[39m
[31m+       const text = e instanceof DashboardHttpError[39m
[31m+         ? e.responseBody.slice(0, 160)[39m
[31m+         : e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e);[39m
[31m+       setMessage({ text: `Erro ao atualizar chamado: ${text}`, kind: "error" });[39m
[31m+     } finally {[39m
[31m+       setTicketBusy(null);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (!props.me) {[39m
[31m+     return ([39m
[31m+       <div className="dashboard-content">[39m

[31m+   }[39m

[31m+ export function moveiteminlist<t extends { id: string }>([39m
[31m+   items: t[],[39m
[31m+   id: string,[39m
[31m+   direction: "up" | "down",[39m
[31m+ ): t[] {[39m
[31m+   const idx = items.findindex((it) => it.id === id);[39m
[31m+   if (idx === -1) return items.slice();[39m
[31m+   const swapwith = direction === "up" ? idx - 1 : idx + 1;[39m
[31m+   if (swapwith < 0 || swapwith >= items.length) return items.slice();[39m
[31m+   const next = items.slice();[39m
[31m+   const a = next[idx]!;[39m
[31m+   const b = next[swapwith]!;[39m
[31m+   next[idx] = b;[39m
[31m+   next[swapwith] = a;[39m
[31m+   return next;[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ export function moveItemInList<T extends { id: string }>([39m
[31m+   items: T[],[39m
[31m+   id: string,[39m
[31m+   direction: "up" | "down",[39m
[31m+ ): T[] {[39m
[31m+   const idx = items.findIndex((it) => it.id === id);[39m
[31m+   if (idx === -1) return items.slice();[39m
[31m+   const swapWith = direction === "up" ? idx - 1 : idx + 1;[39m
[31m+   if (swapWith < 0 || swapWith >= items.length) return items.slice();[39m
[31m+   const next = items.slice();[39m
[31m+   const a = next[idx]!;[39m
[31m+   const b = next[swapWith]!;[39m
[31m+   next[idx] = b;[39m
[31m+   next[swapWith] = a;[39m
[31m+   return next;[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ export function filterTickets<T extends { id: string; buyerMessage: string }>([39m

[31m+       t.id.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||[39m
[31m+       (t.buyerMessage ?? "").toLowerCase().includes(q),[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ export function moveItemInList<T extends { id: string }>([39m
[31m+   items: T[],[39m
[31m+   id: string,[39m
[31m+   direction: "up" | "down",[39m
[31m+ ): T[] {[39m
[31m+   const idx = items.findIndex((it) => it.id === id);[39m
[31m+   if (idx === -1) return items.slice();[39m
[31m+   const swapWith = direction === "up" ? idx - 1 : idx + 1;[39m
[31m+   if (swapWith < 0 || swapWith >= items.length) return items.slice();[39m
[31m+   const next = items.slice();[39m
[31m+   const a = next[idx]!;[39m
[31m+   const b = next[swapWith]!;[39m
[31m+   next[idx] = b;[39m
[31m+   next[swapWith] = a;[39m
[31m+   return next;[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ export function filterTickets<T extends { id: string; buyerMessage: string }>([39m

[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ };[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ // ── Skeleton ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function SupportSkeleton() {[39m
[31m+   return ([39m
[31m+     <div style={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: "var(--space-4)" }}>[39m
[31m+       <div className="skeleton" style={{ height: 52, borderRadius: "var(--radius-md)" }} />[39m
[31m+       <div className="skeleton" style={{ height: 180, borderRadius: "var(--radius-md)" }} />[39m
[31m+       <div className="skeleton" style={{ height: 280, borderRadius: "var(--radius-md)" }} />[39m
[31m+     </div>[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ // ── Component ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ export function SupportSettingsPage(props: { apiBaseUrl: string; me: MerchantMeProfile | null }) {[39m
[31m+   const api = useMemo(() => createDashboardApi({ baseUrl: props.apiBaseUrl }), [props.apiBaseUrl]);[39m
[31m+   const [settings, setSettings] = useState<SupportSettings | null>(null);[39m
[31m+   const [items, setItems] = useState<SupportFaqItem[]>([]);[39m
[31m+   const [tickets, setTickets] = useState<SupportTicket[]>([]);[39m
[31m+   const [ticketStatusFilter, setTicketStatusFilter] = useState<SupportTicketStatus | "all">("all");[39m
[31m+   const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);[39m
[31m+   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);[39m
[31m+   const [ticketBusy, setTicketBusy] = useState<string | null>(null);[39m
[31m+   const [message, setMessage] = useState<{ text: string; kind: "ok" | "error" } | null>(null);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   useEffect(() => {[39m
[31m+     if (!props.me) {[39m
[31m+       setSettings(null);[39m
[31m+       setItems([]);[39m
[31m+       setTickets([]);[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     void load();[39m
[31m+   }, [props.me, ticketStatusFilter]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   async function load() {[39m
[31m+     setLoading(true);[39m
[31m+     setMessage(null);[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const [s, t] = await Promise.all([[39m
[31m+         api.getSupportSettings(),[39m
[31m+         api.getSupportTickets(ticketStatusFilter === "all" ? undefined : ticketStatusFilter)[39m
[31m+       ]);[39m
[31m+       const settings = s && typeof s === "object" && !Array.isArray(s) ? s : null;[39m
[31m+       setSettings(settings);[39m
[31m+       setItems(settings?.faqItems ?? []);[39m
[31m+       setTickets(Array.isArray(t) ? t : []);[39m
[31m+     } catch (e) {[39m
[31m+       const text = e instanceof DashboardHttpError[39m
[31m+         ? e.responseBody.slice(0, 160)[39m
[31m+         : e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e);[39m
[31m+       setMessage({ text: `Erro ao carregar: ${text}`, kind: "error" });[39m
[31m+     } finally {[39m
[31m+       setLoading(false);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   async function save() {[39m
[31m+     setBusy(true);[39m
[31m+     setMessage(null);[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const saved = await api.putSupportSettings({ faqItems: items });[39m
[31m+       setSettings(saved);[39m
[31m+       setItems(saved.faqItems);[39m
[31m+       setMessage({ text: "FAQ salvo com sucesso.", kind: "ok" });[39m
[31m+     } catch (e) {[39m
[31m+       const text = e instanceof DashboardHttpError[39m
[31m+         ? e.responseBody.slice(0, 160)[39m
[31m+         : e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e);[39m
[31m+       setMessage({ text: `Erro ao salvar: ${text}`, kind: "error" });[39m
[31m+     } finally {[39m
[31m+       setBusy(false);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   function updateItem(id: string, field: "question" | "answer", val: string) {[39m
[31m+     setItems((prev) => prev.map((it) => (it.id === id ? { ...it, [field]: val } : it)));[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   function removeItem(id: string) {[39m
[31m+     setItems((prev) => prev.filter((it) => it.id !== id));[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   async function updateTicketStatus(ticketId: string, status: SupportTicketStatus) {[39m
[31m+     setTicketBusy(ticketId);[39m
[31m+     setMessage(null);[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const updated = await api.patchSupportTicketStatus(ticketId, status);[39m
[31m+       setTickets((prev) => prev.map((ticket) => (ticket.id === ticketId ? updated : ticket)));[39m
[31m+       setMessage({ text: "Chamado atualizado.", kind: "ok" });[39m
[31m+     } catch (e) {[39m
[31m+       const text = e instanceof DashboardHttpError[39m
[31m+         ? e.responseBody.slice(0, 160)[39m
[31m+         : e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e);[39m
[31m+       setMessage({ text: `Erro ao atualizar chamado: ${text}`, kind: "error" });[39m
[31m+     } finally {[39m
[31m+       setTicketBusy(null);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (!props.me) {[39m
[31m+     return ([39m
[31m+       <div className="dashboard-content">[39m
[31m+         <header className="page-head">[39m
[31m+           <div>[39m
[31m+             <h1>Atendimento ao Comprador</h1>[39m
[31m+             <p className="page-lead">Login necessário para configurar o atendimento.</p>[39m
[31m+           </div>[39m
[31m+         </header>[39m
[31m+       </div>[39m
[31m+     );[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const openCount = tickets.filter((t) => t.status === "open").length;[39m
[31m+   const inProgressCount = tickets.filter((t) => t.status === "in_progress").length;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return ([39m
[31m+     <div className="dashboard-content">[39m
[31m+       {/* ── Page Head ── */}[39m
[31m+       <header className="page-head">[39m
[31m+         <div>[39m
[31m+           <span className="eyebrow">Atendimento</span>[39m
[31m+           <h1>Atendimento ao Comprador</h1>[39m
[31m+           <p className="page-lead">[39m
[31m+             Configure o atendimento ao comprador durante o checkout.[39m
[31m+             {settings?.updatedAt ? ([39m
[31m+               <> · FAQ atualizado em{" "}[39m
[31m+                 <span style={{ fontFamily: "var(--font-data)", fontSize: 12 }}>[39m
[31m+                   {new Intl.DateTimeFormat("pt-BR", { dateStyle: "short", timeStyle: "short" }).format(new 
Date(settings.updatedAt))}[39m
[31m+                 </span>[39m
[31m+               </>[39m
[31m+             ) : null}[39m
[31m+           </p>[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+         <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 8, alignItems: "center" }}>[39m
[31m+           <button type="button" disabled={loading || busy} onClick={() => void load()} style={{ display: 
"flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 6, padding: "9px 14px", borderRadius: 8, border: "1px solid var(--border)", 
background: "var(--card)", font: "600 12.5px var(--sans)", color: "var(--ink)", cursor: "pointer", height: 36 }}>[39m
[31m+             <RefreshCw size={14} />[39m
[31m+             Atualizar[39m
[31m+           </button>[39m
[31m+           <button[39m
[31m+             type="button"[39m
[31m+             disabled={busy || !settings}[39m
[31m+             onClick={() => void save()}[39m
[31m+             style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 6, padding: "9px 14px", borderRadius: 8, 
border: "none", background: "linear-gradient(150deg, var(--accent), var(--accent-dark))", font: "600 12.5px 
var(--sans)", color: "white", cursor: "pointer", height: 36 }}[39m
[31m+           >[39m
[31m+             <Save size={14} />[39m
[31m+             {busy ? "Salvando…" : "Salvar FAQ"}[39m
[31m+           </button>[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+       </header>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       {/* ── Message ── */}[39m
[31m+       {message ? ([39m
[31m+         <div[39m
[31m+           className={`panel ${message.kind === "error" ? "panel-error" : "panel-info"}`}[39m
[31m+           style={{[39m
[31m+             display: "flex",[39m
[31m+             alignItems: "center",[39m
[31m+             gap: "var(--space-2)",[39m
[31m+             marginBottom: "var(--space-4)",[39m
[31m+           }}[39m
[31m+         >[39m
[31m+           {message.kind === "error" ? ([39m
[31m+             <AlertTriangle size={15} style={{ flexShrink: 0 }} />[39m
[31m+           ) : ([39m
[31m+             <CheckCircle2 size={15} style={{ flexShrink: 0 }} />[39m
[31m+           )}[39m
[31m+           {message.text}[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+       ) : null}[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       {/* ── Loading skeleton ── */}[39m
[31m+       {loading && !settings ? <SupportSkeleton /> : null}[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       {/* ── Ticket summary strip ── */}[39m
[31m+       {!loading && tickets.length > 0 ? ([39m
[31m+         <div[39m
[31m+           style={{[39m

[31m+               {inProgressCount}[39m
[31m+             </strong>[39m
[31m+           </div>[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+       ) : null}[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       {settings ? ([39m
[31m+         <div style={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: "var(--space-5)" }}>[39m
[31m+           {/* ── Hours Section ── */}[39m

[31m+             <div className="panel-title">[39m
[31m+               <h2>Horário de atendimento</h2>[39m
[31m+             </div>[39m
[31m+             <p className="page-lead" style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: 12 }}>Quando o suporte humano está 
disponível</p>[39m
[31m+           </section>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+           {/* ── FAQ Section ── */}[39m
[31m+           <section className="panel stacked">[39m
[31m+             <div className="panel-title">[39m
[31m+               <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: "var(--space-2)" }}>[39m
[31m+                 <div[39m
[31m+                   style={{[39m
[31m+                     width: 30,[39m
[31m+                     height: 30,[39m
[31m+                     borderRadius: "var(--radius-sm)",[39m
[31m+                     background: "var(--color-brand-subtle)",[39m
[31m+                     display: "flex",[39m

[31m+                   <HelpCircle size={15} />[39m

atendimento</p>[39m

[31m+               <span className={`badge ${items.length > 0 ? "ok" : "muted"}`}>[39m
[31m+                 {items.length}/{20} itens[39m
[31m+               </span>[39m
[31m+             </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+             {items.length === 0 ? ([39m
[31m+               <div className="empty-state">[39m

[31m+                   <MessageSquare size={20} />[39m

[31m+                   no checkout sem acionar o handoff humano.[39m

[31m+                 <button[39m

[31m+                   className="btn-secondary"[39m
[31m+                   disabled={busy}[39m

[31m+                 >[39m

[31m+             ) : null}[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+             {items.map((item, idx) => ([39m
[31m+               <div[39m

[31m+                 style={{[39m
[31m+                   display: "flex",[39m
[31m+                   alignItems: "center",[39m

[31m+ export function moveItemInList<T extends { id: string }>([39m
[31m+   items: T[],[39m
[31m+   id: string,[39m
[31m+   direction: "up" | "down",[39m
[31m+ ): T[] {[39m
[31m+   const idx = items.findIndex((it) => it.id === id);[39m
[31m+   if (idx === -1) return items.slice();[39m
[31m+   const swapWith = direction === "up" ? idx - 1 : idx + 1;[39m
[31m+   if (swapWith < 0 || swapWith >= items.length) return items.slice();[39m
[31m+   const next = items.slice();[39m
[31m+   const a = next[idx]!;[39m
[31m+   const b = next[swapWith]!;[39m
[31m+   next[idx] = b;[39m
[31m+   next[swapWith] = a;[39m
[31m+   return next;[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ export function moveItemInList<T extends { id: string }>([39m
[31m+   items: T[],[39m
[31m+   id: string,[39m
[31m+   direction: "up" | "down",[39m
[31m+ ): T[] {[39m
[31m+   const idx = items.findIndex((it) => it.id === id);[39m
[31m+   if (idx === -1) return items.slice();[39m
[31m+   const swapWith = direction === "up" ? idx - 1 : idx + 1;[39m
[31m+   if (swapWith < 0 || swapWith >= items.length) return items.slice();[39m
[31m+   const next = items.slice();[39m
[31m+   const a = next[idx]!;[39m
[31m+   const b = next[swapWith]!;[39m
[31m+   next[idx] = b;[39m
[31m+   next[swapWith] = a;[39m
[31m+   return next;[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ export function filterTickets<T extends { id: string; buyerMessage: string }>([39m
[31m+   tickets: T[],[39m
[31m+   query: string,[39m
[31m+ ): T[] {[39m
[31m+   const q = query.trim().toLowerCase();[39m
[31m+   if (!q) return tickets.slice();[39m
[31m+   return tickets.filter([39m
[31m+     (t) =>[39m
[31m+       t.id.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||[39m
[31m+       (t.buyerMessage ?? "").toLowerCase().includes(q),[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ export function paginateItems<T>([39m
[31m+   items: T[],[39m
[31m+   page: number,[39m
[31m+   pageSize: number,[39m
[31m+ ): { paginated: T[]; hasMore: boolean } {[39m
[31m+   const start = (page - 1) * pageSize;[39m
[31m+   const paginated = items.slice(start, start + pageSize);[39m
[31m+   const hasMore = start + paginated.length < items.length;[39m
[31m+   return { paginated, hasMore };[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ export function moveItemInList<T extends { id: string }>([39m
[31m+   items: T[],[39m
[31m+   id: string,[39m
[31m+   direction: "up" | "down",[39m
[31m+ ): T[] {[39m
[31m+   const idx = items.findIndex((it) => it.id === id);[39m
[31m+   if (idx === -1) return items.slice();[39m
[31m+   const swapWith = direction === "up" ? idx - 1 : idx + 1;[39m
[31m+   if (swapWith < 0 || swapWith >= items.length) return items.slice();[39m
[31m+   const next = items.slice();[39m
[31m+   const a = next[idx]!;[39m
[31m+   const b = next[swapWith]!;[39m
[31m+   next[idx] = b;[39m
[31m+   next[swapWith] = a;[39m
[31m+   return next;[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+       const settings = s && typeof s === "object" && !Array.isArray(s) ? s : null;[39m
[31m+       setSettings(settings);[39m
[31m+       setItems(settings?.faqItems ?? []);[39m
[31m+       setTickets(Array.isArray(t) ? t : []);[39m
[31m+     } catch (e) {[39m
[31m+       const text = e instanceof DashboardHttpError[39m
[31m+         ? e.responseBody.slice(0, 160)[39m
[31m+         : e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e);[39m
[31m+       setMessage({ text: `Erro ao carregar: ${text}`, kind: "error" });[39m
[31m+     } finally {[39m
[31m+       setLoading(false);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   async function save() {[39m
[31m+     setBusy(true);[39m
[31m+     setMessage(null);[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const saved = await api.putSupportSettings({ faqItems: items });[39m
[31m+       setSettings(saved);[39m
[31m+       setItems(saved.faqItems);[39m
[31m+       setMessage({ text: "FAQ salvo com sucesso.", kind: "ok" });[39m
[31m+     } catch (e) {[39m
[31m+       const text = e instanceof DashboardHttpError[39m
[31m+         ? e.responseBody.slice(0, 160)[39m
[31m+         : e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e);[39m
[31m+       setMessage({ text: `Erro ao salvar: ${text}`, kind: "error" });[39m
[31m+     } finally {[39m
[31m+       setBusy(false);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   function updateItem(id: string, field: "question" | "answer", val: string) {[39m
[31m+     setItems((prev) => prev.map((it) => (it.id === id ? { ...it, [field]: val } : it)));[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   function removeItem(id: string) {[39m
[31m+     setItems((prev) => prev.filter((it) => it.id !== id));[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   async function updateTicketStatus(ticketId: string, status: SupportTicketStatus) {[39m
[31m+     setTicketBusy(ticketId);[39m

[31m+       setMessage({ text: "Chamado atualizado.", kind: "ok" });[39m
[31m+     } catch (e) {[39m
[31m+       const text = e instanceof DashboardHttpError[39m
[31m+         ? e.responseBody.slice(0, 160)[39m
[31m+         : e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e);[39m
[31m+       setMessage({ text: `Erro ao atualizar chamado: ${text}`, kind: "error" });[39m
[31m+     } finally {[39m
[31m+       setTicketBusy(null);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m

[31m+ export function moveItemInList<T extends { id: string }>([39m
[31m+   items: T[],[39m
[31m+   id: string,[39m
[31m+   direction: "up" | "down",[39m
[31m+ ): T[] {[39m
[31m+   const idx = items.findIndex((it) => it.id === id);[39m
[31m+   if (idx === -1) return items.slice();[39m
[31m+   const swapWith = direction === "up" ? idx - 1 : idx + 1;[39m
[31m+   if (swapWith < 0 || swapWith >= items.length) return items.slice();[39m
[31m+   const next = items.slice();[39m
[31m+   const a = next[idx]!;[39m
[31m+   const b = next[swapWith]!;[39m
[31m+   next[idx] = b;[39m
[31m+   next[swapWith] = a;[39m
[31m+   return next;[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+     question: !it.question.trim(),[39m
[31m+     answer: !it.answer.trim(),[39m
[31m+   }));[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ export function moveItemInList<T extends { id: string }>([39m
[31m+   items: T[],[39m
[31m+   id: string,[39m
[31m+   direction: "up" | "down",[39m
[31m+ ): T[] {[39m
[31m+   const idx = items.findIndex((it) => it.id === id);[39m
[31m+   if (idx === -1) return items.slice();[39m
[31m+   const swapWith = direction === "up" ? idx - 1 : idx + 1;[39m
[31m+   if (swapWith < 0 || swapWith >= items.length) return items.slice();[39m
[31m+   const next = items.slice();[39m
[31m+   const a = next[idx]!;[39m
[31m+   const b = next[swapWith]!;[39m
[31m+   next[idx] = b;[39m
[31m+   next[swapWith] = a;[39m
[31m+   return next;[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ export function filterTickets<T extends { id: string; buyerMessage: string }>([39m
[31m+   tickets: T[],[39m
[31m+   query: string,[39m
[31m+ ): T[] {[39m
[31m+   const q = query.trim().toLowerCase();[39m
[31m+   if (!q) return tickets.slice();[39m
[31m+   return tickets.filter([39m
[31m+     (t) =>[39m
[31m+       t.id.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||[39m
[31m+       (t.buyerMessage ?? "").toLowerCase().includes(q),[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ export function paginateItems<T>([39m
[31m+   items: T[],[39m
[31m+   page: number,[39m
[31m+   pageSize: number,[39m
[31m+ ): { paginated: T[]; hasMore: boolean } {[39m
[31m+   const start = (page - 1) * pageSize;[39m
[31m+   const paginated = items.slice(start, start + pageSize);[39m
[31m+   const hasMore = start + paginated.length < items.length;[39m
[31m+   return { paginated, hasMore };[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+   const api = useMemo(() => createDashboardApi({ baseUrl: props.apiBaseUrl }), [props.apiBaseUrl]);[39m
[31m+   const [settings, setSettings] = useState<SupportSettings | null>(null);[39m
[31m+   const [items, setItems] = useState<SupportFaqItem[]>([]);[39m
[31m+   const [tickets, setTickets] = useState<SupportTicket[]>([]);[39m
[31m+   const [ticketStatusFilter, setTicketStatusFilter] = useState<SupportTicketStatus | "all">("all");[39m
[31m+   const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);[39m
[31m+   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);[39m
[31m+   const [ticketBusy, setTicketBusy] = useState<string | null>(null);[39m
[31m+   const [message, setMessage] = useState<{ text: string; kind: "ok" | "error" } | null>(null);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   useEffect(() => {[39m
[31m+     if (!props.me) {[39m
[31m+       setSettings(null);[39m
[31m+       setItems([]);[39m
[31m+       setTickets([]);[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     void load();[39m
[31m+   }, [props.me, ticketStatusFilter]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   async function load() {[39m
[31m+     setLoading(true);[39m
[31m+     setMessage(null);[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const [s, t] = await Promise.all([[39m
[31m+         api.getSupportSettings(),[39m
[31m+         api.getSupportTickets(ticketStatusFilter === "all" ? undefined : ticketStatusFilter)[39m
[31m+       ]);[39m
[31m+       const settings = s && typeof s === "object" && !Array.isArray(s) ? s : null;[39m
[31m+       setSettings(settings);[39m
[31m+       setItems(settings?.faqItems ?? []);[39m
[31m+       setTickets(Array.isArray(t) ? t : []);[39m
[31m+     } catch (e) {[39m
[31m+       const text = e instanceof DashboardHttpError[39m
[31m+         ? e.responseBody.slice(0, 160)[39m
[31m+         : e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e);[39m
[31m+       setMessage({ text: `Erro ao carregar: ${text}`, kind: "error" });[39m
[31m+     } finally {[39m
[31m+       setLoading(false);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   async function save() {[39m
[31m+     setBusy(true);[39m
[31m+     setMessage(null);[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const saved = await api.putSupportSettings({ faqItems: items });[39m
[31m+       setSettings(saved);[39m
[31m+       setItems(saved.faqItems);[39m
[31m+       setMessage({ text: "FAQ salvo com sucesso.", kind: "ok" });[39m
[31m+     } catch (e) {[39m
[31m+       const text = e instanceof DashboardHttpError[39m
[31m+         ? e.responseBody.slice(0, 160)[39m
[31m+         : e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e);[39m
[31m+       setMessage({ text: `Erro ao salvar: ${text}`, kind: "error" });[39m
[31m+     } finally {[39m
[31m+       setBusy(false);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   function updateItem(id: string, field: "question" | "answer", val: string) {[39m
[31m+     setItems((prev) => prev.map((it) => (it.id === id ? { ...it, [field]: val } : it)));[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   function removeItem(id: string) {[39m
[31m+     setItems((prev) => prev.filter((it) => it.id !== id));[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   async function updateTicketStatus(ticketId: string, status: SupportTicketStatus) {[39m
[31m+     setTicketBusy(ticketId);[39m

[31m+     try {[39m

[31m+       setTickets((prev) => prev.map((ticket) => (ticket.id === ticketId ? updated : ticket)));[39m
[31m+       setMessage({ text: "Chamado atualizado.", kind: "ok" });[39m
[31m+     } catch (e) {[39m
[31m+       const text = e instanceof DashboardHttpError[39m
[31m+         ? e.responseBody.slice(0, 160)[39m
[31m+         : e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e);[39m
[31m+       setMessage({ text: `Erro ao atualizar chamado: ${text}`, kind: "error" });[39m
[31m+     } finally {[39m
[31m+       setTicketBusy(null);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (!props.me) {[39m
[31m+     return ([39m
[31m+       <div className="dashboard-content">[39m
[31m+         <header className="page-head">[39m
[31m+           <div>[39m

[31m+       </div>[39m

[31m+   }[39m

function newItem(): SupportFaqItem {
  return { id: crypto.randomUUID(), question: \"\", answer: \"\" };
}

export function formatPtBrDate(iso: string): string {
  const d = new Date(iso);
  if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return iso;
  return d.toLocaleDateString(\"pt-BR\", { day: \"2-digit\", month: \"short\", year: \"numeric\", hour: \"2-digit\", 
minute: \"2-digit\" });
}

export function validateFaqItems(items: SupportFaqItem[]): Array<{ question: boolean; answer: boolean }> {
  return items.map((it) => ({
    question: !it.question.trim(),
    answer: !it.answer.trim(),
  }));
}

export function moveItemInList<T extends { id: string }>(
  items: T[],
  id: string,
  direction: \"up\" | \"down\",
): T[] {
  const idx = items.findIndex((it) => it.id === id);
  if (idx === -1) return items.slice();
  const swapWith = direction === \"up\" ? idx - 1 : idx + 1;
  if (swapWith < 0 || swapWith >= items.length) return items.slice();
  const next = items.slice();
  const a = next[idx]!;
  const b = next[swapWith]!;
  next[idx] = b;
  next[swapWith] = a;
  return next;
}

export function filterTickets<T extends { id: string; buyerMessage: string }>(
  tickets: T[],
  query: string,
): T[] {
  const q = query.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!q) return tickets.slice();
  return tickets.filter(
    (t) =>
      t.id.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
      (t.buyerMessage ?? \"\").toLowerCase().includes(q),
  );
}

export function paginateItems<T>(
  items: T[],
  page: number,
  pageSize: number,
): { paginated: T[]; hasMore: boolean } {
  const start = (page - 1) * pageSize;
  const paginated = items.slice(start, start + pageSize);
  const hasMore = start + paginated.length < items.length;
  return { paginated, hasMore };
}

    </div>

// ── Component ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export function SupportSettingsPage(props: { apiBaseUrl: string; me: MerchantMeProfile | null }) {
  const api = useMemo(() => createDashboardApi({ baseUrl: props.apiBaseUrl }), [props.apiBaseUrl]);
  const [settings, setSettings] = useState<SupportSettings | null>(null);
  const [items, setItems] = useState<SupportFaqItem[]>([]);
  const [tickets, setTickets] = useState<SupportTicket[]>([]);
  const [ticketStatusFilter, setTicketStatusFilter] = useState<SupportTicketStatus | \"all\">(\"all\");
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [ticketBusy, setTicketBusy] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [message, setMessage] = useState<{ text: string; kind: \"ok\" | \"error\" } | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!props.me) {
      setSettings(null);
      setItems([]);
      setTickets([]);
      return;
    }
    void load();
  }, [props.me, ticketStatusFilter]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps

  async function load() {
    setLoading(true);
    setMessage(null);
    try {
      const [s, t] = await Promise.all([
        api.getSupportSettings(),
        api.getSupportTickets(ticketStatusFilter === \"all\" ? undefined : ticketStatusFilter)
      ]);
      const settings = s && typeof s === \"object\" && !Array.isArray(s) ? s : null;
      setSettings(settings);
      setItems(settings?.faqItems ?? []);
      setTickets(Array.isArray(t) ? t : []);
    } catch (e) {
      const text = e instanceof DashboardHttpError
        ? e.responseBody.slice(0, 160)
        : e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e);
      setMessage({ text: `Erro ao carregar: ${text}`, kind: \"error\" });
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  async function save() {
    setBusy(true);
    setMessage(null);
    try {
      const saved = await api.putSupportSettings({ faqItems: items });
      setSettings(saved);
      setItems(saved.faqItems);
      setMessage({ text: \"FAQ salvo com sucesso.\", kind: \"ok\" });
    } catch (e) {
      const text = e instanceof DashboardHttpError
        ? e.responseBody.slice(0, 160)
        : e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e);
      setMessage({ text: `Erro ao salvar: ${text}`, kind: \"error\" });
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  function updateItem(id: string, field: \"question\" | \"answer\", val: string) {
    setItems((prev) => prev.map((it) => (it.id === id ? { ...it, [field]: val } : it)));
  }

  function removeItem(id: string) {
    setItems((prev) => prev.filter((it) => it.id !== id));
  }

  async function updateTicketStatus(ticketId: string, status: SupportTicketStatus) {
    setTicketBusy(ticketId);
    setMessage(null);
    try {
      const updated = await api.patchSupportTicketStatus(ticketId, status);
      setTickets((prev) => prev.map((ticket) => (ticket.id === ticketId ? updated : ticket)));
      setMessage({ text: \"Chamado atualizado.\", kind: \"ok\" });
    } catch (e) {
      const text = e instanceof DashboardHttpError
        ? e.responseBody.slice(0, 160)
        : e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e);
      setMessage({ text: `Erro ao atualizar chamado: ${text}`, kind: \"error\" });
    } finally {
      setTicketBusy(null);
    }
  }

  if (!props.me) {
    return (
      <div className=\"dashboard-content\">
        <header className=\"page-head\">
          <div>
            <h1>Atendimento ao Comprador</h1>
            <p className=\"page-lead\">Login necessário para configurar o atendimento.</p>
          </div>
        </header>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const openCount = tickets.filter((t) => t.status === \"open\").length;
  const inProgressCount = tickets.filter((t) => t.status === \"in_progress\").length;

  return (
    <div className=\"dashboard-content\">
      {/* ── Page Head ── */}
      <header className=\"page-head\">
        <div>
          <span className=\"eyebrow\">Atendimento</span>
          <h1>Atendimento ao Comprador</h1>
          <p className=\"page-lead\">
            Configure o atendimento ao comprador durante o checkout.
            {settings?.updatedAt ? (
              <> · FAQ atualizado em{\" \"}
                <span style={{ fontFamily: \"var(--font-data)\", fontSize: 12 }}>
                  {new Intl.DateTimeFormat(\"pt-BR\", { dateStyle: \"short\", timeStyle: \"short\" }).format(new 
Date(settings.updatedAt))}
                </span>
              </>
            ) : null}
          </p>
        </div>
        <div style={{ display: \"flex\", gap: 8, alignItems: \"center\" }}>
          <button type=\"button\" disabled={loading || busy} onClick={() => void load()} style={{ display: \"flex\", 
alignItems: \"center\", gap: 6, padding: \"9px 14px\", borderRadius: 8, border: \"1px solid var(--border)\", 
background: \"var(--card)\", font: \"600 12.5px var(--sans)\", color: \"var(--ink)\", cursor: \"pointer\", height: 36 
}}>
            <RefreshCw size={14} />
            Atualizar
          </button>
          <button
            type=\"button\"
            disabled={busy || !settings}
            onClick={() => void save()}
            style={{ display: \"flex\", alignItems: \"center\", gap: 6, padding: \"9px 14px\", borderRadius: 8, 
border: \"none\", background: \"linear-gradient(150deg, var(--accent), var(--accent-dark))\", font: \"600 12.5px 
var(--sans)\", color: \"white\", cursor: \"pointer\", height: 36 }}
          >
            <Save size={14} />
            {busy ? \"Salvando…\" : \"Salvar FAQ\"}
          </button>
        </div>
      </header>

      {/* ── Message ── */}
      {message ? (
        <div
          className={`panel ${message.kind === \"error\" ? \"panel-error\" : \"panel-info\"}`}
          style={{
            display: \"flex\",
            alignItems: \"center\",
            gap: \"var(--space-2)\",
            marginBottom: \"var(--space-4)\",
          }}
        >
          {message.kind === \"error\" ? (
            <AlertTriangle size={15} style={{ flexShrink: 0 }} />
          ) : (
            <CheckCircle2 size={15} style={{ flexShrink: 0 }} />
          )}
          {message.text}
        </div>
      ) : null}

      {/* ── Loading skeleton ── */}
      {loading && !settings ? <SupportSkeleton /> : null}

      {/* ── Ticket summary strip ── */}
      {!loading && tickets.length > 0 ? (
        <div
          style={{
            display: \"grid\",
            gridTemplateColumns: \"repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr))\",
            gap: \"var(--space-3)\",
            marginBottom: \"var(--space-5)\",
          }}
        >
          <div className=\"metric\">
            <span>Total de chamados</span>
            <strong>{tickets.length}</strong>
          </div>
          <div className=\"metric\">
            <span>Em aberto</span>
            <strong style={{ color: openCount > 0 ? \"var(--color-warning)\" : undefined }}>
              {openCount}
            </strong>
          </div>
          <div className=\"metric\">
            <span>Em atendimento</span>

[31m+[39m
[31m+   async function updateTicketStatus(ticketId: string, status: SupportTicketStatus) {[39m
[31m+     setTicketBusy(ticketId);[39m
[31m+     setMessage(null);[39m

[31m+       setTickets((prev) => prev.map((ticket) => (ticket.id === ticketId ? updated : ticket)));[39m

[31m+       setTicketBusy(null);[39m

[31m+   }[39m

[31m+ export function moveItemInList<T extends { id: string }>([39m
[31m+   items: T[],[39m
[31m+   id: string,[39m
[31m+   direction: "up" | "down",[39m
[31m+ ): T[] {[39m
[31m+   const idx = items.findIndex((it) => it.id === id);[39m
[31m+   if (idx === -1) return items.slice();[39m
[31m+   const swapWith = direction === "up" ? idx - 1 : idx + 1;[39m
[31m+   if (swapWith < 0 || swapWith >= items.length) return items.slice();[39m
[31m+   const next = items.slice();[39m
[31m+   const a = next[idx]!;[39m
[31m+   const b = next[swapWith]!;[39m
[31m+   next[idx] = b;[39m
[31m+   next[swapWith] = a;[39m
[31m+   return next;[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ export function filterTickets<T extends { id: string; buyerMessage: string }>([39m

[31m+       t.id.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||[39m

[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ export function moveItemInList<T extends { id: string }>([39m
[31m+   items: T[],[39m
[31m+   id: string,[39m
[31m+   direction: "up" | "down",[39m
[31m+ ): T[] {[39m
[31m+   const idx = items.findIndex((it) => it.id === id);[39m
[31m+   if (idx === -1) return items.slice();[39m
[31m+   const swapWith = direction === "up" ? idx - 1 : idx + 1;[39m
[31m+   if (swapWith < 0 || swapWith >= items.length) return items.slice();[39m
[31m+   const next = items.slice();[39m
[31m+   const a = next[idx]!;[39m
[31m+   const b = next[swapWith]!;[39m
[31m+   next[idx] = b;[39m
[31m+   next[swapWith] = a;[39m
[31m+   return next;[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+   open: "Aberto",[39m
[31m+   in_progress: "Em atendimento",[39m
[31m+   resolved: "Resolvido",[39m
[31m+   closed: "Fechado"[39m
[31m+ };[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ const SUPPORT_STATUSES = Object.keys(SUPPORT_STATUS_LABELS) as SupportTicketStatus[];[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ const STATUS_BADGE: Record<SupportTicketStatus, string> = {[39m
[31m+   open: "warn",[39m
[31m+   in_progress: "muted",[39m
[31m+   resolved: "ok",[39m
[31m+   closed: "muted",[39m
[31m+ };[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ const STATUS_DOT: Record<SupportTicketStatus, string> = {[39m
[31m+   open: "amber",[39m
[31m+   in_progress: "blue",[39m
[31m+   resolved: "green",[39m
[31m+   closed: "",[39m
[31m+ };[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ // ── Skeleton ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function SupportSkeleton() {[39m
[31m+   return ([39m
[31m+     <div style={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: "var(--space-4)" }}>[39m
[31m+       <div className="skeleton" style={{ height: 52, borderRadius: "var(--radius-md)" }} />[39m
[31m+       <div className="skeleton" style={{ height: 180, borderRadius: "var(--radius-md)" }} />[39m
[31m+       <div className="skeleton" style={{ height: 280, borderRadius: "var(--radius-md)" }} />[39m
[31m+     </div>[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ // ── Component ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ export function SupportSettingsPage(props: { apiBaseUrl: string; me: MerchantMeProfile | null }) {[39m
[31m+   const api = useMemo(() => createDashboardApi({ baseUrl: props.apiBaseUrl }), [props.apiBaseUrl]);[39m
[31m+   const [settings, setSettings] = useState<SupportSettings | null>(null);[39m
[31m+   const [items, setItems] = useState<SupportFaqItem[]>([]);[39m
[31m+   const [tickets, setTickets] = useState<SupportTicket[]>([]);[39m
[31m+   const [ticketStatusFilter, setTicketStatusFilter] = useState<SupportTicketStatus | "all">("all");[39m
[31m+   const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);[39m
[31m+   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);[39m
[31m+   const [ticketBusy, setTicketBusy] = useState<string | null>(null);[39m
[31m+   const [message, setMessage] = useState<{ text: string; kind: "ok" | "error" } | null>(null);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   useEffect(() => {[39m
[31m+     if (!props.me) {[39m
[31m+       setSettings(null);[39m
[31m+       setItems([]);[39m
[31m+       setTickets([]);[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     void load();[39m
[31m+   }, [props.me, ticketStatusFilter]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   async function load() {[39m
[31m+     setLoading(true);[39m
[31m+     setMessage(null);[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const [s, t] = await Promise.all([[39m
[31m+         api.getSupportSettings(),[39m
[31m+         api.getSupportTickets(ticketStatusFilter === "all" ? undefined : ticketStatusFilter)[39m
[31m+       ]);[39m
[31m+       const settings = s && typeof s === "object" && !Array.isArray(s) ? s : null;[39m
[31m+       setSettings(settings);[39m
[31m+       setItems(settings?.faqItems ?? []);[39m
[31m+       setTickets(Array.isArray(t) ? t : []);[39m
[31m+     } catch (e) {[39m
[31m+       const text = e instanceof DashboardHttpError[39m
[31m+         ? e.responseBody.slice(0, 160)[39m
[31m+         : e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e);[39m
[31m+       setMessage({ text: `Erro ao carregar: ${text}`, kind: "error" });[39m
[31m+     } finally {[39m
[31m+       setLoading(false);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   async function save() {[39m
[31m+     setBusy(true);[39m
[31m+     setMessage(null);[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const saved = await api.putSupportSettings({ faqItems: items });[39m
[31m+       setSettings(saved);[39m
[31m+       setItems(saved.faqItems);[39m
[31m+       setMessage({ text: "FAQ salvo com sucesso.", kind: "ok" });[39m
[31m+     } catch (e) {[39m
[31m+       const text = e instanceof DashboardHttpError[39m
[31m+         ? e.responseBody.slice(0, 160)[39m
[31m+         : e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e);[39m
[31m+       setMessage({ text: `Erro ao salvar: ${text}`, kind: "error" });[39m
[31m+     } finally {[39m
[31m+       setBusy(false);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   function updateItem(id: string, field: "question" | "answer", val: string) {[39m
[31m+     setItems((prev) => prev.map((it) => (it.id === id ? { ...it, [field]: val } : it)));[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   function removeItem(id: string) {[39m
[31m+     setItems((prev) => prev.filter((it) => it.id !== id));[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   async function updateTicketStatus(ticketId: string, status: SupportTicketStatus) {[39m
[31m+     setTicketBusy(ticketId);[39m
[31m+     setMessage(null);[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const updated = await api.patchSupportTicketStatus(ticketId, status);[39m
[31m+       setTickets((prev) => prev.map((ticket) => (ticket.id === ticketId ? updated : ticket)));[39m
[31m+       setMessage({ text: "Chamado atualizado.", kind: "ok" });[39m
[31m+     } catch (e) {[39m
[31m+       const text = e instanceof DashboardHttpError[39m
[31m+         ? e.responseBody.slice(0, 160)[39m
[31m+         : e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e);[39m
[31m+       setMessage({ text: `Erro ao atualizar chamado: ${text}`, kind: "error" });[39m
[31m+     } finally {[39m
[31m+       setTicketBusy(null);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (!props.me) {[39m
[31m+     return ([39m
[31m+       <div className="dashboard-content">[39m
[31m+         <header className="page-head">[39m
[31m+           <div>[39m
[31m+             <h1>Atendimento ao Comprador</h1>[39m
[31m+             <p className="page-lead">Login necessário para configurar o atendimento.</p>[39m
[31m+           </div>[39m
[31m+         </header>[39m
[31m+       </div>[39m
[31m+     );[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const openCount = tickets.filter((t) => t.status === "open").length;[39m
[31m+   const inProgressCount = tickets.filter((t) => t.status === "in_progress").length;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return ([39m
[31m+     <div className="dashboard-content">[39m
[31m+       {/* ── Page Head ── */}[39m
[31m+       <header className="page-head">[39m
[31m+         <div>[39m
[31m+           <span className="eyebrow">Atendimento</span>[39m
[31m+           <h1>Atendimento ao Comprador</h1>[39m
[31m+           <p className="page-lead">[39m
[31m+             Configure o atendimento ao comprador durante o checkout.[39m
[31m+             {settings?.updatedAt ? ([39m
[31m+               <> · FAQ atualizado em{" "}[39m
[31m+                 <span style={{ fontFamily: "var(--font-data)", fontSize: 12 }}>[39m
[31m+                   {new Intl.DateTimeFormat("pt-BR", { dateStyle: "short", timeStyle: "short" }).format(new 
Date(settings.updatedAt))}[39m
[31m+                 </span>[39m
[31m+               </>[39m
[31m+             ) : null}[39m
[31m+           </p>[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+         <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 8, alignItems: "center" }}>[39m
[31m+           <button type="button" disabled={loading || busy} onClick={() => void load()} style={{ display: 
"flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 6, padding: "9px 14px", borderRadius: 8, border: "1px solid var(--border)", 
background: "var(--card)", font: "600 12.5px var(--sans)", color: "var(--ink)", cursor: "pointer", height: 36 }}>[39m
[31m+             <RefreshCw size={14} />[39m
[31m+             Atualizar[39m
[31m+           </button>[39m
[31m+           <button[39m
[31m+             type="button"[39m
[31m+             disabled={busy || !settings}[39m
[31m+             onClick={() => void save()}[39m
[31m+             style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 6, padding: "9px 14px", borderRadius: 8, 
border: "none", background: "linear-gradient(150deg, var(--accent), var(--accent-dark))", font: "600 12.5px 
var(--sans)", color: "white", cursor: "pointer", height: 36 }}[39m
[31m+           >[39m
[31m+             <Save size={14} />[39m
[31m+             {busy ? "Salvando…" : "Salvar FAQ"}[39m
[31m+           </button>[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+       </header>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       {/* ── Message ── */}[39m
[31m+       {message ? ([39m
[31m+         <div[39m
[31m+           className={`panel ${message.kind === "error" ? "panel-error" : "panel-info"}`}[39m
[31m+           style={{[39m
[31m+             display: "flex",[39m
[31m+             alignItems: "center",[39m
[31m+             gap: "var(--space-2)",[39m
[31m+             marginBottom: "var(--space-4)",[39m
[31m+           }}[39m
[31m+         >[39m
[31m+           {message.kind === "error" ? ([39m
[31m+             <AlertTriangle size={15} style={{ flexShrink: 0 }} />[39m
[31m+           ) : ([39m
[31m+             <CheckCircle2 size={15} style={{ flexShrink: 0 }} />[39m
[31m+           )}[39m
[31m+           {message.text}[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+       ) : null}[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       {/* ── Loading skeleton ── */}[39m
[31m+       {loading && !settings ? <SupportSkeleton /> : null}[39m
